paper_metadata.title: Influence of Nb addition on microstructural evolution and compression mechanical properties of Ti-Zr alloys

evidence.quote: Herein, we aimed to investigate the influence of Nb addition on phase composition, microstructural evolution and mechanical properties of Ti-50Zr (at.%) alloys.
Pure Ti (≥99.99 wt. %), Zr (≥99.7 wt. %) and Nb (≥99.99 wt. %) wires were used to prepare (100-x)/2Ti-(100-x)/2Zr-xNb (x = 0, 5, 10, 20, and 33.33 at. %) ingots.
The TZ0N alloy consists of only α phase with close-packed hexagonal (HCP) structure
TZ5N alloy consists of α phase, α" phase, with orthorhombic structure, and β phase with body-centered cubic (BCC) structure
α and α" phases have not been detected in TZ10N, TZ20N and TZN alloys, with higher Nb content, and only β phase was observed.
The (211) peak of TZ20N and TZN alloys consists of two diffraction peaks with different angles, indicating the presence of two different BCC structures in TZ20N and TZN alloys, i.e., β' and β".
The TZ20N and TZN alloys decompose into Nb-poor and Nb-rich β phase.
